chapter: Buffalo, Lunceford, Lil Armstrong and Stuff Smith
title: Stuff Smith takes over the Vendome band
summary: Eddie Tompkins and Jones were asked back but Jones had already gone with Stuff, who took over the Vendome band with pianist Jimmy Sherman, bassist Sylvester Turpin, drummer Buster Nash and trombonist Gus Wilson.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Then Eddie Tompkins -- because we left the band and Eddie Tompkins left the same time I did, and then he come back. Because he come after me again, too. He said, 'I think I've got a chance to go in the Cotton Club. I would like you guys, you and Eddie, to come back.' And so I'm playing now -- by that time I was with Stuff, but I'd been playing around with Stuff too a little bit, because I had to quit his band to pay rent. So now, in the meantime, we go back, after Willy Bryant and them leave, back into the Vendome, but Stuff has got the band.
See, Stuff's got the band when we go back. Stuff takes the band over.
Luke is not in it, then.
I don't think Luke was in that band. I think they had Jimmy Sherman, who used to be with the Charioteers, on the piano.
And bass was a guy named Turpin, Sylvester Turpin. Drums was Buster Nash. Trumpet was me. Trombone was Teddy Wilson's brother, Gus.
